bounces.description: Visits that left after one page.

conversion_rate_percent.description: Share of visits that reached a goal, in percent, e.g. 7.4.

converted_visits.description: Visits that reached at least one goal or placed an order.

new_visits.description: Visits by people who hadn't visited before.

outbound_link_clicks.description: Clicks on links to other websites.

period_end.description: The last day the report covers, e.g. 2026-09-30.

period_start.description: The first day the report covers, e.g. 2026-09-01.

returning_visits.description: Visits by people who had visited before.

revenue.description: Revenue from goals and orders, in the website's currency.

site_searches.description: Searches made with the website's own search box.

unique_pageviews.description: Pages viewed, counting each page once a visit.

unique_visitors.description: Different visitors. Null when your Matomo isn't set to count them for this kind of period, which by default is a month, a year or a date range.

parameters.name: since

parameters.description: How many to return, the biggest first.
parameters.name: limit

actions.description: How many things the visitor did.

activity.description: Everything the visitor did, in order.

time_spent_seconds.description: Seconds spent on a page view. Null for anything else.

title.description: The page's title, the goal's name, the search typed, or the event as category / action / name. Null when there is none.

type.description: What the visitor did: page view, download, outbound link, event, goal, site search, order, abandoned cart, form, media or error.

url.description: The page, file or link address. Null when there is none.

campaign.description: The campaign their link was tagged with. Null for none.

channel.description: The kind of source, e.g. Search Engines or Direct Entry.

converted.description: Whether the visit reached a goal.

device.description: The device's maker and model, e.g. Apple iPhone.

duration_seconds.description: How long the visit has lasted so far, in seconds.

entry_page_url.description: The first page viewed. Null when none was.

exit_page_url.description: The last page viewed. Null when none was.

goal_conversions.description: How many goals the visit reached.

language.description: Their browser's language. Null when unknown.

last_action_at.description: When the visitor last did something.

pages_viewed.description: How many pages the visitor viewed.

referrer_name.description: The search engine, website or social network they came from, e.g. Google. Null for a direct visit.

referrer_url.description: The page they came from. Null when unknown.

revenue.description: What the visitor ordered, in the website's currency.

search_keyword.description: What they searched for, when the search engine says. Usually null.

user_id.description: The signed-in user's id, when the website tells Matomo. Usually null.

visit_id.description: Matomo's number for the visit, to tell visits apart.

visit_number.description: How many visits this visitor has made, this one included.

total.description: How many websites the user can see in all.

websites.description: The websites, oldest first, so the first is usually the main one.

created_at.description: When it was added to Matomo, e.g. 2011-06-27T09:42:22Z.

currency.description: The currency its revenue is in, e.g. USD.

ecommerce.description: Whether Matomo tracks the website's online orders.

id.description: Matomo's number for the website, which the Website field of the other Matomo steps takes.

site_search.description: Whether Matomo tracks the website's own search box.
